Container.Name: rememberry
Container.Overview: Rememberry: a small personal app for people dossiers (photo, birthday, kids, how you met, work, notes, tags, dated quick notes) and a one-paragraph-a-day journal with moods, photos, @mentions and an on-this-day view. Optional birthday reminders via ntfy, Pushover, Discord or email. Owner account with username and password (hashed, lockouts, CSRF-protected), light and dark mode. Installable as a PWA over HTTPS. Forgot the password? docker exec -it rememberry python -m app.cli reset-password. SQLite and photo uploads live in /data.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database (rememberry.db) and uploaded photos (uploads/). Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Legacy password
Config.Description: Legacy, leave empty on new installs: you create a username and password in the app on first run. Old installs: keeps working until you create your account, then it is ignored and can be removed.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: auto (Secure over HTTPS), true (always; use behind an HTTPS reverse proxy) or false.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy IPs
Config.Description: Behind a reverse proxy, its IP (or *) so lockouts see real client IPs and HTTPS is detected.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Decides what 'today' is for the journal, e.g. Australia/Sydney.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Legacy. Only signs the old APP_PASSWORD cookie.

Config.Name: Reminder days ahead
Config.Description: Birthday reminders are sent this many days ahead and on the day.

Config.Name: Reminder hour
Config.Description: Earliest hour (0-23, in TZ) to send the daily birthday reminder.

Config.Name: ntfy URL
Config.Description: Optional. ntfy server (default https://ntfy.sh) or a full topic URL.

Config.Name: ntfy topic
Config.Description: Optional. ntfy topic to send birthday reminders to.

Config.Name: ntfy token
Config.Description: Optional. Access token for a protected ntfy topic.

Config.Name: Pushover app token
Config.Description: Optional. Pushover application API token.

Config.Name: Pushover user key
Config.Description: Optional. Pushover user or group key.

Config.Name: Discord webhook URL
Config.Description: Optional. Discord channel webhook for birthday reminders.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Optional. Mail server for email reminders (needs SMTP_TO too).

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: Optional. Defaults to 587, or 465 when SMTP_SECURITY is ssl.

Config.Name: SMTP security
Config.Description: starttls, ssl or none.

Config.Name: SMTP user
Config.Description: Optional. SMTP login.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: Optional. SMTP password.

Config.Name: SMTP from
Config.Description: Optional. From address; defaults to SMTP_USER.

Config.Name: SMTP to
Config.Description: Optional. Address(es) to email reminders to, comma-separated.
